title: Frozen auxiliary10 deployment-policy experiment: single full-FIT vs bag-of-five inference (private-first pseudo-test)
scientific_question: Does replacing the certified aux10 deployment policy (one full-FIT refit per role, 100% of FIT) with a bag-of-five inner-fold members per role (each ~80% of FIT, equal mean-logit) improve the complete v7 ranking on a frozen pseudo-test (primary fold 4)?

standard.note: This changes test-time inference only; OOF is unchanged. It CANNOT pass the OOF admission gate and is NOT a private-performance proof. It is matched diagnostic evidence for finalist selection under a frozen protocol.
standard.s6e9_caveat: S6E9's deployment bagging precedent moved finalists +2.6e-4 private, but pseudo-test deltas do not transfer cleanly to private. Measured fold-4 evidence is conditional on this split.

frozen_pseudotest.labels_use: pseudotest labels used ONLY for final AUC/pair/segment evaluation; never in feature fitting, ES, tree-count, bagging, weight selection, or model selection
frozen_pseudotest.honesty: Fold 4 has been used in earlier campaign research (it is part of the primary OOF). This is NOT a genuinely new hidden holdout; it provides matched diagnostic evidence only.

control.policy: single full-FIT refit per role (certified aux10 deployment policy)
control.source: certified primary fold-4 aux10 member predictions under tag sol_clean_aux10_primary
verification: classical(4, 'sol_clean_aux10_primary') contract verification (role config, params, fold membership, tree counts, row-ID order, feature hashes, source hashes, finite [0,1] probabilities)
control portfolio sigmoid((logit(route4)+aux10_control_logits)/2).astype(float32) reproduces artifacts/phase17_B1/f4/portfolio.npy bit-exact (max abs diff == 0.0)
control.fit_population: each role r trains on np.flatnonzero(scheme_folds != 4); for primary-scheme roles this is folds 0-3 (= FIT, 559708 rows). Non-primary roles use their certified immutable scheme and train population (recorded, not modified).

treatment.policy: bag-of-five inner-fold members per role, equal mean-logit

inner_partitions.algorithm: StratifiedKFold(5, shuffle=True, random_state=20261022) restricted to the FIT index set (primary folds 0-3), stratified on y
inner_partitions.excludes_pseudotest: no fold-4 row ever appears in any bag member's training set

per_role_per_member.training_set: FIT minus inner partition i (i=0..4); ~80% of FIT
per_role_per_member.inner_es: _inner_es_split(bag_fit, y, seed=1) — 10% carved from bag_fit, never pseudotest
per_role_per_member.features: reproduce the role's certified feature-generation protocol on the bag subset: ViewBuilder(role.view).assemble(bag_fit, y, fold4_idx, inner_seed=inner) then add_expected_values (aux EV probability_cache, seed=1, rounds=250, inner_folds=3) rebuilt strictly inside bag_fit
per_role_per_member.params: role's certified hyperparameters and categorical-encoding semantics, unchanged
per_role_per_member.dispatch: same model-specific fit functions as the certified fold (fit_slot for lgbm-aux, fit_xgb for xgb-aux, native CatBoost attach for cat-aux C1), preserving each model's tree-count/ES semantics
per_role_per_member.prediction: probability on pseudotest rows; save exact row IDs and hashes

aggregation.family_level: equal mean over the 5 bag members' logits per role (logit(p) with clip to [1e-7,1-1e-7])
aggregation.role_level: equal mean-logit over the 10 roles, matching the certified aux10 mean-logit method
aggregation.forbidden: no averaging of incompatible probability and logit vectors; no best-bag selection by pseudotest AUC

evaluation.route: unchanged certified TabPFN route prediction on primary fold 4 (artifacts/phase17_B1/f4/prediction.npy)
metrics: exact paired AUC delta (treatment - control) on identical fold-4 rows
pair rescue/damage with credit correct=1, tie=0.5, wrong=0; net pair credit must reproduce the exact AUC delta
Spearman rank correlation (control vs treatment portfolio)
logit Pearson correlation (control vs treatment portfolio)

segment effects (predeclared: Gender, Customer Type, Type of Travel, Class, Age quartiles, Flight Distance quartiles, Departure Delay in Minutes>0, Arrival Delay in Minutes>0, unique-rating-key vs not)
prediction-scale changes (mean/quantiles of |treatment - control| probability, sign flips)
differences from the certified fold-4 baseline (control must be bit-exact)
evaluation.recompute_from_vectors: every metric recomputed from actual prediction vectors; portfolio gain never inferred from auxiliary standalone gain

classification.NEGATIVE: bag5 portfolio AUC delta < -3e-5, OR bag5 is significantly worse (delta <= -3e-5 AND |delta| >= 3x paired SE)
classification.PROMISING_DIAGNOSTIC: bag5 portfolio AUC delta >= +3e-5 AND delta >= 3x paired SE AND aux standalone delta > 0
classification.NEUTRAL: everything between NEGATIVE and PROMISING (|delta| < +3e-5, or delta >= +3e-5 but < 3x SE, or aux standalone non-positive)
classification.INVALID: any protocol/numerical defect (non-disjointness, pseudotest leakage, TE/aux nesting error, wrong config/counts/fold/rows/trees/IDs/aggregation, non-finite output, control non-identity, v7 mutation)
classification.RESOURCE_BLOCKED: the complete predefined comparison cannot finish within the authorized CPU budget

even_if_promising: do not claim full OOF increased
do not use public score to choose the policy
a promising result requires a separately preregistered replication on another matched pseudo-test split (identical model params/weights) before any deployment change is considered

compute.gpu: H19-B is CPU-classical; no new heavy GPU training. XGB aux roles carry device='cuda' in their certified config (light hist method, ~11-30s/fit) and are preserved unchanged to honor 'identical config'; these count as light GPU use, not heavy GPU.
compute.pilot: a single-role pilot may measure resource/numerical fidelity only; its AUC MUST NOT choose which roles enter the full candidate set
compute.budget_rule: before all 50 fits: measure one member cost, estimate remaining runtime, inspect feature-cache reuse, verify CPU budget, RAM, disk; if the complete comparison cannot finish, stop with a resource report rather than silently reducing the family set

forbidden_training_inputs: any pseudotest (fold-4) label in feature fitting, ES, tree-count, bagging, weight selection, model selection
anti_leakage.te_nesting: TE and aux-EV rebuilt strictly inside each bag member's training set (mirroring the certified outer-fold policy at bag scale)
anti_leakage.expected_rating_crossfit: aux EV probability_cache cross-fits inside bag_fit; apply rows are fold 4 (disjoint from bag_fit)
anti_leakage.preregistered_scope_resolution: The phase19 registry entry (committed earlier) described a generic 5-fold-carve experiment. The mission specifies the concrete instantiation (aux10 roles on primary fold 4). This prereg binds that exact instantiation; the generic registry text is a scope sketch, not a different experiment. No fold-0-fitted role is reused for folds 1-4 (that would leak); each role uses its certified native scheme with fold 4 held out.

v7_protection.no_mutation: all artifacts/phase17_B1/*, artifacts/sol_clean_aux10_primary/*, experiments/private_finalists.json, submissions/* are read-only for this experiment
hashes_verified_at_start: portfolio fold k hashes (CHAMPION_PORTFOLIO_SHA256) and route fold k hashes (CHAMPION_ROUTE_SHA256) over full OOF arrays

budget_and_submissions.note: H19-B cannot satisfy the OOF-gain submission rule; it is finalist-selection evidence only.
